name: seething-intercession-banished-attack-activatable-when-legal-costs-two-damage
notes: Seething Intercession (5Xfg69S1XX), positive pin for the validate-first banish activation: the same seeded Striking Tides on player 2's turn 2 (no first-turn lock). The click costs 2 unpreventable damage to player 2's champion (step 2), 3 reserve payments (steps 3-5) and the attack hits player 1's champion for 4 (step 6). Guards against the refusal gates over-refusing a legal activation. CAVEAT: the permission tag is seeded.

rulesClauses: As an additional cost to activate each of those cards, deal 2 unpreventable damage to your champion.
